name: 33606 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33606 (Tampa) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33606 (Tampa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
